entries.entry: A sly fox with a scorpion's curled tail. Its sting drips venom that keeps eating at foes after the hit.

entries.lore: Vespyx hunts at dusk, darting in to sting and slipping away before the venom starts its slow work. It buries spare prey in shallow scrapes across the fields, then forgets where half of them are.

entries.name: Vespox

entries.entry: Armoured bruiser, sting grown into a scythe blade.
entries.lore: Its sting has hardened into a curved steel blade that it carries high like a reaper's scythe. Glaivyx still walks its old patrol route in full armour, and the trees along the way are now scored deep enough to fell.
entries.name: Sabryx

entries.entry: An axolotl whose frills grew into living crystal. It bends light into shields and dazzling beams.
entries.habitat: Wild, on any island of the Skylands.
entries.lore: The frills of a Prismander are living crystal, and they grow fastest in direct sunlight, so wild ones bask at the edges of the islands. When a friend is in danger, it bends that light into a shimmering wall.
entries.name: Prismander

d.lore: Glass-bodied axolotl, prism gills.
d.quirk: Chirps whenever a rainbow shows, often minutes before anyone else spots it.

entries.entry: Glass-bodied axolotl, prism gills.
entries.lore: Light passes straight through its glass body, and the prism gills scatter colour across the ground. Glassolotl chirps whenever a rainbow appears, often minutes before anyone else has noticed one.
entries.name: Glassolotl

d.lore: Gills become a crystal chandelier crown.

entries.entry: Gills become a crystal chandelier crown.
entries.lore: Its gills have grown into a crown of crystal drops that chimes softly as it walks. Old island halls once hung a sleeping Chandelotl from the rafters in place of a lamp, and it never seemed to mind.
entries.name: Crystalotl

entries.entry: A hedgehog whose quills are glowing toadstools. It puffs spore clouds that root foes where they stand.

entries.lore: The quills on its back are glowing toadstools that puff out spores when it is startled. After rain, Mycroll rolls happily through compost heaps, and the next night its footprints shine faintly across the yard.

d.lore: Porcupine whose quills are mushroom stalks.

entries.entry: Porcupine whose quills are mushroom stalks.
entries.lore: Its quills are tall mushroom stalks that loosen in damp weather. Farm cooks gather the few it sheds each wet morning, dry them by the stove, and crumble them into stews for a smoky taste.
entries.name: Sporcupine

d.lore: Huge calm elder, a fairy ring grove on its back, shelf-fungus armour.

entries.entry: Huge calm elder, a fairy ring grove on its back, shelf-fungus armour.
entries.lore: A ring of mushrooms grows in a perfect circle on the back of this calm elder, with shelf fungus layered over its sides like armour. Small Boki nap inside the ring, and Ringrove will stand still for hours rather than wake them.
entries.name: Ringrove

entries.lore: Lunowl hunts only on clear nights, gliding on soft moth wings and dazzling prey with a flash of silver light. When clouds cover the moon, it dozes in the rafters and will happily eat from your hand.

entries.habitat: Wild, on any island of the Skylands.
entries.lore: Those long ears catch footsteps far beyond anyone else's hearing. Echolop thumps a hind foot twice before a visitor comes into view, then bolts off in a burst of ringing pulses, mostly because it loves to win races.

entries.entry: Anchorhorn, art-lane design.

entries.habitat: Wild, on any island of the Skylands.
entries.lore: Its belly is a bronze temple bell, and it rings itself at sunrise every morning, so nobody on the farm ever sleeps late. Gongibbon sings when it is happy and sings even louder when it is scared.
entries.name: Gongibbon

d.quirk: Each dent in its gong crest is a fight it remembers; it will not let you polish them.

entries.entry: Roaring gibbon with a gong crest grown from its skull.
entries.lore: A gong crest has grown from its skull, and each dent in it marks a fight Gongrowl remembers. It roars rather than sings now, and it will not let anyone polish the dents away.
entries.name: Gongrowl

entries.lore: Puddles are for paddling, as far as Kayak is concerned. This yak calf's head ends in the pointed bow of a kayak, and it floats about on its back for fun, refusing to come out no matter how cold the water gets.
entries.name: Kayak

entries.lore: Ice armour covers this colossal yak like the hull of a warship. On hot days Dreadnoyak breathes frost to cool itself, and farmhands make a habit of working downwind of it.
entries.name: Dreadnoyak

entries.habitat: Wild, on any island of the Skylands.
entries.lore: Its back is a split geode lined with quartz, and its star-shaped nose feels the ground shake long before anyone else can. Glintmole pops out of its burrow a minute before a tremor, and other farm Boki follow it out.
entries.name: Glintmole

d.lore: Bigger mole, cracked-geode back.
d.quirk: Sorts dug-up stones by colour into little piles outside its burrow.

entries.entry: Bigger mole, cracked-geode back.
entries.lore: The geode on its back has cracked wider as it grew. Geodemole sorts the stones it digs up by colour into neat little piles outside its burrow, and it fusses if anyone mixes them.
entries.name: Geodemole

d.quirk: Grows a new amethyst spike every full moon; the old ones can be traded.

entries.lore: Its back has become a whole amethyst cavern, and its claws are crystal. Druzemole grows a new spike every full moon and sheds the oldest, which islanders trade at market.
entries.name: Gemole

entries.lore: Gloamshell's shell is smoked obsidian glass that drinks the light around it. Lanterns burn dimmer wherever it crawls and it leaves a trail of dusk behind, so wise farmers keep it out of the barn at night.
entries.name: Duskargot

entries.entry: Evolution of Gloamshell.
entries.lore: Over the years its shell grows into a dark crystal spire taller than a house, and Gloamspire slowly becomes part of it. Travellers mistake one for a ruined tower until its eyestalks turn to watch them pass.
entries.name: Duskspire

entries.name: Glomwort

entries.entry: Evolution of Glomwort.
entries.lore: Glombulus is a whole hill of yellow slime crowned with mushrooms, and green veins pulse through it when it is pleased. It no longer creeps toward spilled food; it simply grows until the food is underneath it.
entries.name: Glombulus

entries.lore: Effigeetle is a beetle the size of a cart, its shell carved like the face of a marble statue. The face splits open down the nose when it spreads its wings to carry a rider across a gap. Rain on the marble makes it sneeze, so it will not fly in rain.
entries.name: Sculptillar

entries.entry: Evolution of Effigeetle.
entries.lore: Effigoon hangs from a single cord in a marble cocoon wound with gold, with no face showing at all. Islanders who find one on a cliff leave it untouched, since whatever is changing inside can be heard ticking softly on still nights.
entries.name: Effigoon

d.lore: Evolution of Effigoon.

entries.entry: Evolution of Effigoon.
entries.lore: What climbs out of the marble cocoon is half butterfly and half siege engine, with brass-ribbed wings and a calm stone face. Mortarfly lobs stones from high above and folds its wings with a click once the fight is over.
entries.name: Mortarfly

entries.entry: A highland cow with a walled garden on its back; you ride sitting on the garden wall. Gentle and stubborn, grazes mid-fight; bellows proudly when you climb on.
entries.habitat: Wild, on any island of the Skylands.
entries.lore: Crofthorn carries a walled garden on its back, and riders sit on the wall. Herbs planted there grow twice as fast as those in the ground. With years of grazing and tending, the garden grows into a whole cottage, and Crofthorn becomes Crofthollow.
entries.name: Crofthorn

d.lore: Crofthollow, art-lane design.

entries.entry: Crofthollow, art-lane design.
entries.lore: Crofthollow is a Crofthorn whose garden has grown into a whole stone cottage, thatched, rose-covered and smoking from the chimney. A family of small Boki usually lives inside, and it walks slowly so as not to spill their supper.
entries.name: Crofthollow

d.lore: Fluffy heron chick wobbling on tiny skate blades.
d.quirk: Only stays upright on ice; on grass it topples and peeps for help.

entries.entry: Fluffy heron chick wobbling on tiny skate blades.
entries.lore: On ice, Skidlet glides about quite happily on its tiny skate blades. Set the fluffy heron chick down on grass, though, and it topples over at once and peeps until someone helps it up.
entries.name: Skidlet

abilities.name: Stormwing
abilities.text: Skateron wraps you in a living storm for 10s. Chaining bolts, a hover over any gap, a double storm blink, and Fuse again calls a thunderhead down on everyone near.

entries.habitat: Wild, on any island of the Skylands.
entries.lore: Skateron stands motionless at a frozen pond's edge for hours, then strikes exactly once with its ice-pick beak and glides away. It says little, and it seems to approve of people only when they stand very still.
entries.name: Skateron

d.lore: Ice-armoured heron, beak an ice lance, blade feathers.
d.quirk: Its blade feathers hum in wind; a high whine means a gale tonight.

entries.entry: Ice-armoured heron, beak an ice lance, blade feathers.
entries.lore: Armoured in ice, this heron carries a beak as long as a lance. The blade feathers on its wings hum in the wind, and fishing villages listen for a high whine that means a gale is coming tonight.
entries.name: Lanceron

d.lore: Stoat whose tail is a calligraphy brush, cream coat like a blank page.
d.quirk: Dips its tail in any ink or mud and scribbles on your walls.

entries.entry: Stoat whose tail is a calligraphy brush, cream coat like a blank page.
entries.lore: Minkee's tail is a soft calligraphy brush, and its cream coat is as blank as a fresh page. It dips the brush in any ink or mud it finds and scribbles on your walls. What its coat becomes depends on what it learns to paint with.
entries.name: Minkee

d.lore: Flame-brush tail, fiery brushstroke coat.
d.quirk: Draws warm strokes on cold mornings; frost melts wherever it writes.

entries.entry: Flame-brush tail, fiery brushstroke coat.
entries.lore: Once Minkee's brush catches fire, its coat fills with fiery strokes and the bristles glow like embers. Flarmink paints warm lines on cold mornings, and frost melts wherever it writes.
entries.name: Embermink

d.lore: Otter-sleek, wave strokes, webbed paws.
d.quirk: Paints wave lines on the shore that show how high the next tide reaches.

entries.entry: Otter-sleek, wave strokes, webbed paws.
entries.lore: Sleek as an otter, with webbed paws and wave strokes rippling down its coat. Rippmink paints lines along the shore that show exactly how high the next tide will reach, and fishermen trust them more than any almanac.
entries.name: Rippmink

d.lore: Leaf-bristle brush, painted petals and vines.
d.quirk: Petals it paints bloom real by morning if left on good soil.

entries.entry: Leaf-bristle brush, painted petals and vines.
entries.lore: Its brush has sprouted leaf bristles, and painted petals and vines wind across its fur. Petals Blossmink paints on good soil are real flowers by morning, so gardeners lay out fresh beds for it in spring.
entries.name: Blossmink

d.lore: Wire-bristle brush, zig-zag lightning strokes.
d.quirk: Its strokes crackle; on dry days its fur stands on end and shocks you.

entries.entry: Wire-bristle brush, zig-zag lightning strokes.
entries.lore: Voltmink's brush bristles are copper wire, and its lightning strokes crackle as they dry. On dry days its fur stands on end, and anyone who pets it gets a sharp shock for their trouble.
entries.name: Voltmink

d.lore: Icicle brush, frost-lace strokes, long and sleek.
d.quirk: Paints frost lace on windows at dawn, never the same pattern twice.

entries.entry: Icicle brush, frost-lace strokes, long and sleek.
entries.lore: Long and sleek, with a brush of icicles. At dawn Rimink paints frost lace across window panes, and in all the years islanders have watched, no one has seen it paint the same pattern twice.
entries.name: Rimink

d.lore: Soaked jet-black, smoking brush.
d.quirk: Its ink never dries; whatever it marks stays smudged for days.

entries.entry: Soaked jet-black, smoking brush.
entries.lore: Umbrink looks permanently soaked in black ink, and its brush trails smoke. The ink never dries, so whatever it touches stays smudged for days, and a dark paw print on the door is how you know it visited.
entries.name: Nightmink

d.lore: Silver ink, crescent strokes, moth-feather ears.
d.quirk: Only paints under moonlight; by day the silver fades to nothing.

entries.entry: Silver ink, crescent strokes, moth-feather ears.
entries.lore: Moth-feather ears and silver crescent strokes mark this Minkee of the night. Lunink only paints under moonlight, and by morning its silver pictures have faded to nothing, leaving only the people who stayed up to see them.
entries.name: Lunink

d.lore: Rainbow ink that splits light.
d.quirk: Each stroke splits into a rainbow when the sun hits it.

entries.entry: Rainbow ink that splits light.
entries.lore: The ink in its brush splits light, and every stroke Prismink paints breaks into a rainbow when the sun hits it. Children chase it across the yard to stand in the colours it leaves behind.
entries.name: Prismink

d.lore: Long, serpentine ink-dragon stoat.
d.quirk: Coils through the air leaving a trailing ink line that fades in seconds.

entries.entry: Long, serpentine ink-dragon stoat.
entries.lore: The longest and rarest of Minkee's forms, a serpentine ink dragon that coils through the air. Wyrmink leaves a trailing line of ink behind it as it flies, and the line fades in seconds, like writing no one was meant to read.
entries.name: Wyrmink

d.lore: A rope snake with mushroom caps growing from its knots; lay it across a path and whoever steps over it gets rooted. Quiet, thoughtful, an old soul; likes damp shade and long naps.
d.quirk: Sleeps across doorways; the household learns to step over, never on.

temper.name: Thoughtful
temper.play: Pins foes down and breaks up their pushes.

entries.entry: A rope snake with mushroom caps growing from its knots; lay it across a path and whoever steps over it gets rooted. Quiet, thoughtful, an old soul; likes damp shade and long naps.
entries.habitat: Wild, on any island of the Skylands.
entries.lore: A rope snake with mushroom caps sprouting from its knots. Knotwyrm sleeps across doorways, and anyone who steps on it rather than over it gets rooted to the spot. The household soon learns.
entries.name: Knotwyrm

abilities.name: Prism Wall
abilities.text: Thrumbird raises a 4m crystal wall at the spot: enemy shots that hit it bounce back at them. Lasts 4.5s or 140 damage.

abilities.name: Echolocate
abilities.text: On its own in a fight, Thrumbird pings: every rival within 18m is revealed through grass and walls for 3s, and your next shots for 1.5s crit.

abilities.name: Prism Shell
abilities.text: Thrumbird grows a crystal shell around you for 10s. Piercing shards, a prism that throws shots back, a healing crystal wall, and Fuse again shatters the shell outward.

aff.text: Raised to fight hard: it trades a little toughness for bite.

aff.grant: Moves 1 stat point from speed to health.
aff.label: Steadfast
aff.text: Raised to look after you: slower, sturdier.

aff.grant: Moves 1 stat point from damage to your regen.
aff.label: Curious
aff.text: Raised to explore: it hits softer and keeps you patched up.

aff.grant: Moves 1 stat point from health to speed.
aff.label: Swift
aff.text: Raised on the move: lighter and quicker.

d.group: Small Boki: grown and final forms
d.lore: A hummingbird whose forked tail rings like a tuning fork. Its hum steadies your aim and rattles your foes.
d.quirk: Hums one steady note while you work; tools held nearby shake less.

temper.name: Bright
temper.play: Keeps you alive and patched up.

entries.entry: A hummingbird whose forked tail rings like a tuning fork. Its hum steadies your aim and rattles your foes.
entries.habitat: Wild, on any island of the Skylands.
entries.lore: Thrumbird's forked tail rings like a tuning fork. It hums one steady note while you work, and tools held near it shake less. The same hum rattles anything that means you harm.
entries.name: Thrumbird

d.group: Small Boki: grown and final forms
d.lore: Lyrebird whose tail is a harp of strings.
d.quirk: Learns any tune played near it by the third hearing.

entries.entry: Lyrebird whose tail is a harp of strings.
entries.lore: Its tail has grown into a harp of shining strings. Lyrewing learns any tune played near it by the third hearing and plays it back, sometimes better than the original.
entries.name: Lyrewing

d.group: Small Boki: grown and final forms
d.lore: Tiny tuatara with a little latch crest.
d.quirk: Clicks its latch open and shut when thinking; a long click means yes.
d.sexNote: Warm eggs hatch male, cool hatch female

entries.entry: Tiny tuatara with a little latch crest.
entries.lore: Latchling clicks the latch on its crest open and shut while it thinks, and a long click means yes. Warm eggs hatch males and cool eggs hatch females.
entries.name: Latchling

abilities.name: Boulder Heave
abilities.text: Lockatara heaves a rune-lit boulder 8m. Where it lands everyone within 2.6m is thrown up and stunned; anyone already airborne is spiked.

abilities.name: Mass Guard
abilities.text: When you're under fire, Lockatara curls into a heavy plate in front of you for 3s that stops enemy shots (120 HP).

abilities.name: Cairn Colossus
abilities.text: Lockatara rises into a rune-carved colossus under you for 8s: a stone shell takes the hits first, and every stomp quakes the ground and stuns.

d.group: Small Boki: grown and final forms
d.lore: A lizard with a padlock shackle for a crest and a keyhole for a third eye; its tail is the key. Ancient, calm, faintly amused; watches you through the keyhole when you are not looking.
d.quirk: Picks one box to guard and only its tail key will open it.
d.sexNote: Warm eggs hatch male, cool hatch female

temper.name: Ancient
temper.play: Stands in front and soaks the hits.

entries.entry: A lizard with a padlock shackle for a crest and a keyhole for a third eye; its tail is the key. Ancient, calm, faintly amused; watches you through the keyhole when you are not looking.
entries.habitat: Wild, on any island of the Skylands.
entries.lore: Lockatara's crest is a padlock shackle, its third eye is a keyhole, and its tail is the key. It picks one box to guard, and only that key will open it. It likes to watch you through the keyhole when you are not looking.
entries.name: Lockatara

d.group: Small Boki: grown and final forms
d.lore: Huge tuatara with a vault-door shell.
d.quirk: Lets smaller farm Boki shelter inside its shell during storms.
d.sexNote: Warm eggs hatch male, cool hatch female

entries.entry: Huge tuatara with a vault-door shell.
entries.lore: This huge tuatara's shell has become a vault door. During storms Vaultara swings it open and lets the smaller farm Boki shelter inside until the weather passes.
entries.name: Vaultara

d.group: Big Boki: baby form, then a bigger final
d.lore: Baby sloth, folded bone-rib arms like a closed umbrella.
d.quirk: Opens its rib arms a crack when rain is coming; a good forecast.

entries.entry: Baby sloth, folded bone-rib arms like a closed umbrella.
entries.lore: When rain is coming, Parasolth opens its bone-rib arms a crack, like an umbrella that cannot decide. The baby sloth is right more often than the farm almanac.
entries.name: Parasolth

entries.category: Giant ground sloth + Ragged black umbrella

abilities.name: Gravity Slam
abilities.text: Umbrathere drops onto the spot like a meteor: everything within 3.5m is sucked into the crater and flung up; anyone already airborne is spiked.

abilities.name: Mass Guard
abilities.text: When you're under fire, Umbrathere curls into a heavy plate in front of you for 3s that stops enemy shots (120 HP).

abilities.name: Heavy Star
abilities.text: Umbrathere folds into you as a heavy star for 10s. Slam with the left button, roll through foes with the right, drag them in with E, then Fuse again brings the whole sky down.

d.group: Big Boki: baby form, then a bigger final
d.lore: A giant ground sloth with a ragged umbrella for a back; it opens it and your whole squad disappears underneath. Brooding and protective; shelters smaller Boki under its arms when it rains.
d.quirk: Shelters any small Boki in rain and growls at those who refuse to come under.

temper.name: Brooding
temper.play: Stands in front and soaks the hits.

entries.entry: A giant ground sloth with a ragged umbrella for a back; it opens it and your whole squad disappears underneath. Brooding and protective; shelters smaller Boki under its arms when it rains.
entries.habitat: Wild, on any island of the Skylands.
entries.lore: Ribbrella's back is a ragged black umbrella, and when it opens it, a whole party can vanish underneath. In rain it gathers small Boki under its arms and growls at any that refuse to come in.
entries.name: Ribbrella

abilities.name: Hive Swarm
abilities.text: Pipewurm looses a buzzing swarm in a 5m cone: stung, poisoned and slowed. The swarm then hangs over the spot for 3s, stinging anyone inside.

abilities.name: Spore Patch
abilities.text: On its own, when foes bunch up, Pipewurm puffs a 4s spore cloud on them: slowed and taking damage while inside.

abilities.name: Hive Crown
abilities.text: Pipewurm crowns you with its hive for 7s: 20% more damage, and every shot stings, poisons and slows.

d.lore: A velvet-cake worm with icing nozzles for a face; it pipes sticky poison icing that glues your feet down. Looks sweet, hunts like a cat; loves being stroked, hates being ignored.
d.quirk: Pipes little icing flowers onto whoever strokes it; sticky but sweet.

temper.name: Soft
temper.play: Pins foes down and breaks up their pushes.

d.voice: soft and sweet, a little sinister

entries.entry: A velvet-cake worm with icing nozzles for a face; it pipes sticky poison icing that glues your feet down. Looks sweet, hunts like a cat; loves being stroked, hates being ignored.
entries.habitat: Wild, on any island of the Skylands.
entries.lore: Stroke a Pipewurm and it pipes little sugar flowers onto your hand. The velvet worm looks just like a cake, with icing nozzles for a face, but its other icing is sticky poison that glues prey to the ground.
entries.name: Pipewurm

d.lore: Evolution of Pipewurm.

entries.entry: Evolution of Pipewurm.
entries.lore: Pipeworth has grown long, pink and lumpy, with frills of sour green icing along its back. The nozzle on its face drips constantly, and everything it has piped stays stuck where it landed for days.
entries.name: Pipeworth

d.lore: Otter pup, tail a little paddle.
d.quirk: Paddles in circles in any bucket left out and squeaks for applause.

entries.entry: Otter pup, tail a little paddle.
entries.lore: Oarlet is an otter pup with a little paddle for a tail. It paddles in circles in any bucket left out in the yard, then squeaks and squeaks until somebody applauds.
entries.name: Oarlet

d.lore: Otter with oar-blade tail and oar spines.
d.quirk: Rows across the farm pond at sunset, always exactly three laps.

entries.entry: Otter with oar-blade tail and oar spines.
entries.lore: Oar spines line the body of this otter, and its tail has become a full oar blade. Oarter rows across the farm pond at sunset, always exactly three laps, never two.
entries.name: Oarter

d.lore: War-galley otter: oar spines down its sides, ram brow.
d.quirk: Rams anything floating in the pond and stacks the wreckage on the bank.

entries.entry: War-galley otter: oar spines down its sides, ram brow.
entries.lore: Built like a war galley, Galleotter has oar spines down both sides and a ram for a brow. It rams anything floating in the pond and stacks the wreckage neatly on the bank.
entries.name: Galleotter

d.lore: Tiny serpent with paper-kite fins.
d.quirk: Catches updrafts off the roof and hovers there until called down.

entries.entry: Tiny serpent with paper-kite fins.
entries.lore: Kitlet catches updrafts off the roof on fins like a paper kite and hovers there for hours. The tiny serpent comes down only when someone calls its name.
entries.name: Kitlet

d.lore: Long kite-tail dragon, ribbon streamers.
d.quirk: Its streamers point into the wind; sky-fishers watch which way they stream.

entries.entry: Long kite-tail dragon, ribbon streamers.
entries.lore: Long ribbon streamers trail from this kite-tailed dragon. They always point into the wind, and sky fishers watch which way Ribbonwyrm's streamers fly before casting their lines.
entries.name: Ribbonwyrm

d.lore: Majestic sky dragon, kite-frame wings, crossbar spine.
d.quirk: Only flies when the wind is up; on still days it lies on the warm roof.

entries.entry: Majestic sky dragon, kite-frame wings, crossbar spine.
entries.heroNote: owner 11-09: prefers earlier cream dragon over busy red one
entries.lore: Dragonkite's wings are stretched over a frame like a great kite, with a crossbar down its spine. It only flies when the wind is up; on still days it lies on a warm roof and waits.
entries.name: Kitedrake

d.lore: Hermit crab living in a glass jar.
d.quirk: Swaps jars when it finds a prettier one and leaves the old one at your door.

entries.entry: Hermit crab living in a glass jar.
entries.lore: Instead of a shell, Jarmit lives in a glass jar. Whenever it finds a prettier one, it moves in at once and leaves the old jar on your doorstep, as if returning something it borrowed.
entries.name: Jarmit

d.lore: Moves into an oil lantern.
d.quirk: Glows as dusk falls and dims when strangers come near.

entries.entry: Moves into an oil lantern.
entries.lore: This Jarmit has moved into an old oil lantern and taken on its glow. Lanternmit brightens as dusk falls and dims to almost nothing when strangers come near.
entries.name: Lanternmit

d.lore: Moves into a coil-wrapped storm bottle.
d.quirk: Its bottle crackles louder before a storm; keep it off the wooden shelf.

entries.entry: Moves into a coil-wrapped storm bottle.
entries.lore: Stormit lives in a storm bottle wrapped in copper coil, and tiny lightning bolts flicker inside the glass. Before a storm the bottle crackles louder, so keepers move it off any wooden shelf.
entries.name: Stormit

d.lore: Moves into a mossy terrarium.
d.quirk: The moss in its shell grows a single flower when it is content.

entries.entry: Moves into a mossy terrarium.
entries.lore: Some Jarmit settle into a mossy terrarium and never leave. The moss inside Terrarimit's glass grows a single flower when it is content, and the flower wilts within the hour if it is upset.
entries.name: Terrarimit

d.lore: A nautilus that is a tiny bathysphere.

entries.entry: A nautilus that is a tiny bathysphere.
entries.lore: Bathilus sinks to the bottom of deep ponds to look around through its single round porthole eye. The tiny bathysphere rises again later with bubbles streaming from its rivets.
entries.name: Bathilus

entries.category: Orthocone (extinct straight-shelled nautiloid) + torpedo (the eye is the nose, the arms are the fins)

d.lore: A living torpedo whose seeker nose is Bathilus's porthole eye and whose arms have fused into its tail fins.

entries.entry: A living torpedo whose seeker nose is Bathilus's porthole eye and whose arms have fused into its tail fins.
entries.lore: Torpecone is a living torpedo. The porthole eye it had as Bathilus is now its seeker nose, and its arms have fused into tail fins. Once it locks onto something, it does not turn aside.
entries.name: Torpecone

d.lore: A giant ammonite that is a battleship.

entries.entry: A giant ammonite that is a battleship.
entries.lore: A giant ammonite that is a whole battleship, its coiled shell bristling with armour plate. When Dreadmonite surfaces, every smaller Boki in the water gets out of its way, and so do the boats.
entries.name: Dreadmonite

d.lore: A platypus whose bill is a folded pocket knife.

entries.entry: A platypus whose bill is a folded pocket knife.
entries.name: Pocketpus

d.lore: A platypus that is an open multi-tool.

entries.entry: A platypus that is an open multi-tool.
entries.lore: Bladypus is a platypus that opens out like a multi-tool, with a little blade, file or hook for every job. The spurs on its hind legs carry venom, so it is best handed back the way it was passed to you.
entries.name: Bladypus

d.lore: A pufferfish that is a cartoon bomb.

entries.entry: A pufferfish that is a cartoon bomb.
entries.lore: When Puffuse gets nervous it puffs up and the fuse on its head starts to fizz. The pufferfish is shaped exactly like a round cartoon bomb, so the kindest thing is to calm it down quickly.
entries.name: Puffuse

d.lore: A spiny puffer that has hardened into a grenade.

entries.entry: A spiny puffer that has hardened into a grenade.
entries.lore: Its spines have hardened into the iron casing of a grenade. Blastopuff stays perfectly calm almost all the time, which is just as well, because the one time it loses its temper is usually remembered.
entries.name: Blastopuff

d.lore: A single living drop of glossy black ink.

entries.entry: A single living drop of glossy black ink.
entries.lore: Shy enough to hide in an inkwell, Blotlet is a single living drop of glossy black ink. It leaves a tiny dot wherever it rests, and a page covered in dots means it slept on your desk.
entries.name: Blotlet

d.lore: A spreading pool of living ink that creeps along the ground (the former Umbrink design, evolutions/Slog.jpg).

entries.entry: A spreading pool of living ink that creeps along the ground (the former Umbrink design, evolutions/Slog.jpg).
entries.lore: Slog is a spreading pool of living ink that creeps along the ground, a grinning shadow just beneath the surface. Lamps flicker when it passes under a door, and it seems to enjoy that very much.
entries.name: Slog

entries.category: Ink tidal wave + looming shadow beast

d.lore: The ink pool risen into a towering wave of shadow.

entries.entry: The ink pool risen into a towering wave of shadow.
entries.lore: The ink pool has risen into a towering wave of shadow with something looming inside it. Sloggoth moves without a sound, and where it rolls back, the ground is left stained black for a season.
entries.name: Sloggoth

d.lore: A tadpole with a dart-flight tail.

entries.entry: A tadpole with a dart-flight tail.
entries.name: Bullpole

d.lore: A poison dart frog that is the whole game of darts.

entries.entry: A poison dart frog that is the whole game of darts.
entries.lore: Bullsfrog never misses the centre ring, and it sulks when anyone else does. The poison dart frog carries a dartboard on its back and darts for fingers.
entries.name: Bullsfrog

d.lore: A baby centipede of stacked steel bottle caps, their crimped edges its many little legs.

entries.entry: A baby centipede of stacked steel bottle caps, their crimped edges its many little legs.
entries.lore: Clinkpede clinks softly as it walks on the crimped edges of the steel bottle caps it is made of. The baby centipede hunts scrapyards for new caps to add to its length.
entries.name: Clinkpede

d.lore: A centipede that is a living chainsaw chain.

entries.entry: A centipede that is a living chainsaw chain.
entries.name: Chainipede

d.lore: A wombat joey that is a fuzzy die.

entries.entry: A wombat joey that is a fuzzy die.
entries.lore: When Cubbat tumbles over, islanders call out the number of pips that lands on top. The wombat joey is a fuzzy die, and some villages play whole games of chance around it.
entries.name: Cubwom

d.lore: A wombat whose rump is a six-pip shield die.

entries.entry: A wombat whose rump is a six-pip shield die.
entries.name: Pipwom

d.lore: A glyptodont-sized wombat whose shell is a twenty-sided die.

entries.entry: A glyptodont-sized wombat whose shell is a twenty-sided die.
entries.name: Critwom

entries.category: Hellgrammite larva + crossed swords (the mandibles are the blades)

d.lore: A curled river larva carrying its two blade jaws crossed in an X, like crossed swords.

entries.entry: A curled river larva carrying its two blade jaws crossed in an X, like crossed swords.
entries.lore: A curled river larva carrying its two blade jaws crossed in an X, like a pair of swords. Grammite hides under stones in fast streams and raises its blades at anything that lifts the stone.
entries.name: Grammite

d.lore: A dobsonfly whose jaws are crossed cavalry sabres.

entries.entry: A dobsonfly whose jaws are crossed cavalry sabres.
entries.lore: When Grammite leaves the river, its jaws become a pair of crossed cavalry sabres. Dobsabre flies at dusk with them held high and salutes before every duel.
entries.name: Dobsabre

d.lore: A baby chameleon curled up like a rolled star chart, peering through one brass lens eye.

entries.entry: A baby chameleon curled up like a rolled star chart, peering through one brass lens eye.
entries.lore: Curled up like a rolled star chart, Lensling peers out through one brass lens eye. The baby chameleon spends whole nights staring at a single star and sulks if clouds cover it.
entries.name: Lensling

d.lore: A chameleon whose swivelling eyes are two brass spyglasses.

entries.entry: A chameleon whose swivelling eyes are two brass spyglasses.
entries.lore: Scopeleon's swivelling eyes are two brass spyglasses that extend to look at anything far away. It can watch a hawk on one island and a skiff on the next at the same time.
entries.name: Scopeleon

d.lore: A giant chameleon that is a living observatory, its crest a great telescope.

entries.entry: A giant chameleon that is a living observatory, its crest a great telescope.
entries.lore: This giant chameleon is a living observatory, its crest a great brass telescope. Star charts made by people who stayed up beside Domeleon are said to show stars no one else has seen.
entries.name: Domeleon

entries.category: Fawn + broad dappled mushroom caps (grown as its ears)

d.lore: A resting fawn whose two big floppy ears are dappled mushroom caps.

entries.entry: A resting fawn whose two big floppy ears are dappled mushroom caps.
entries.lore: Fawngus lies so still in the leaf litter that foragers have tried to pick its ears, which are big, floppy, dappled mushroom caps. The fawn has never quite forgiven them.
entries.name: Fawnshroom

d.lore: An Irish elk whose antlers are a hat stand hung with mushroom caps.

entries.entry: An Irish elk whose antlers are a hat stand hung with mushroom caps.
entries.lore: Hatstag is a towering elk whose antlers are a hat stand, hung with mushroom caps of every size. Travellers hang their own hats there too, and it seems proud to carry them.
entries.name: Hatstag

d.lore: A bat pup folded up like a closed fan.

entries.entry: A bat pup folded up like a closed fan.
entries.lore: Foldbat rests folded up like a closed fan. When the bat pup flicks itself open, it gives off a sharp crack of sound that scatters anything nearby, and then it folds shut again, embarrassed.
entries.name: Foldbat

d.lore: A flying fox whose wings are iron war fans.

entries.entry: A flying fox whose wings are iron war fans.
entries.name: Fanpire

d.lore: A Gila monster whose beaded hide is an abacus.

entries.entry: A Gila monster whose beaded hide is an abacus.
entries.lore: The beaded hide of this Gila monster is an abacus, with rows of beads that slide as it breathes. Gilabacus keeps count of everything, and market traders swear it knows when it has been shortchanged.
entries.name: Gilabacus

entries.category: Woolly mammoth + ice sculpture (chisel-cut glacier ice, blued-steel tusks)

d.lore: A mammoth carved from one colossal block of glacier ice, like a banquet ice sculpture come alive.

entries.entry: A mammoth carved from one colossal block of glacier ice, like a banquet ice sculpture come alive.
entries.lore: Glaciammoth is carved from one colossal block of glacier ice, its tusks blued steel, like a banquet ice sculpture come to life. On warm days it stands in the shade, fretting about its chisel lines.
entries.name: Glaciammoth

d.lore: The cave folklore 'baby dragon', made of mended porcelain.

entries.entry: The cave folklore 'baby dragon', made of mended porcelain.
entries.lore: Cave folk once told stories of baby dragons, and Olmlet is where those stories came from. It is pale, blind and made of porcelain mended many times over, and it cheeps when it hears footsteps.
entries.name: Olmlet

d.lore: A salamander of crackle-glaze pottery mended with gold.

entries.entry: A salamander of crackle-glaze pottery mended with gold.
entries.lore: Glazolm is a salamander of crackle-glaze pottery, every crack filled with gold. It keeps its old breaks proudly on show and gets a little brighter each time it is mended.
entries.name: Glazolm

d.lore: A dragon that was shattered and glued back together with gold.

entries.entry: A dragon that was shattered and glued back together with gold.
entries.lore: A dragon that was shattered and glued back together with gold, more seams than porcelain by now. Kintsuwyrm is said to be stronger at every mended place, and it shows them off when it uncoils.
entries.name: Gildwyrm

d.lore: A spiderling with a sand-timer belly.

entries.entry: A spiderling with a sand-timer belly.
entries.lore: Grainspin's belly is a sand timer. The sand runs from top to bottom over exactly one hour, and when the last grain falls, the spiderling flips over and starts the next.
entries.name: Grainspin

d.lore: A black widow whose red hourglass mark is a real glass hourglass.

entries.entry: A black widow whose red hourglass mark is a real glass hourglass.
entries.lore: The red hourglass on this black widow's belly is a real glass hourglass. Sandwidow waits on its web until the sand runs out, and whatever is caught by then is dinner.
entries.name: Sandwidow

d.lore: A giant spider that is a toppled hourglass half buried in a desert.

entries.entry: A giant spider that is a toppled hourglass half buried in a desert.
entries.name: Hourachnid

entries.category: Baby frilled lizard + vinyl record (the open frill disc)

d.lore: A baby frilled lizard whose round open frill is a black vinyl record, its face the label.

entries.entry: A baby frilled lizard whose round open frill is a black vinyl record, its face the label.
entries.lore: Spin a Tootle and its frill plays a scratchy little tune. The baby frilled lizard's round open frill is a black vinyl record, with its own face as the label.
entries.name: Tootle

d.lore: A frilled lizard whose frill is a gramophone horn.

entries.entry: A frilled lizard whose frill is a gramophone horn.
entries.lore: Gramofrill's frill has opened out into a gramophone horn. It plays back songs it heard years ago, crackle and all, and it hates being interrupted halfway through a track.
entries.name: Gramofrill

d.lore: A dragon whose crown is four gramophone horns.

entries.entry: A dragon whose crown is four gramophone horns.
entries.lore: A dragon crowned with four gramophone horns, each pointing in a different direction. Phonodrake can play four songs at once, and when it roars, all four join in.
entries.name: Phonodrake

d.lore: A grub that has curled itself into a crescent moon. (Redesigned 11-09: four rounds kept drawing a grub hugging a separate moon ball, which reads as a held object.).

entries.entry: A grub that has curled itself into a crescent moon. (Redesigned 11-09: four rounds kept drawing a grub hugging a separate moon ball, which reads as a held object.).
entries.lore: Gravigrub curls itself into a crescent moon and sleeps all day. At night it rolls out, and small loose things nearby slowly start to circle it.
entries.name: Gravigrub

d.lore: A dung beetle whose rear end is a ringed planet.

entries.entry: A dung beetle whose rear end is a ringed planet.
entries.lore: Orbitle is a dung beetle whose rear end is a ringed planet. Small pebbles drift along its rings, and anything it rolls along the ground tends to follow it home.
entries.name: Orbitle

d.lore: A three-headed hydra that is living garden topiary in full hydrangea bloom.

entries.entry: A three-headed hydra that is living garden topiary in full hydrangea bloom.
entries.lore: A three-headed hydra that is a garden topiary in full hydrangea bloom. Each head flowers a different colour, and if one is clipped too short, the other two will not stop complaining.
entries.name: Hydrangor

entries.category: Katydid nymph + ball of rising dough

d.lore: A katydid nymph that is a ball of rising dough.

entries.entry: A katydid nymph that is a ball of rising dough.
entries.lore: Proofhop swells a little bigger every warm afternoon, a katydid nymph made of rising dough. It sinks back down sulking if anyone pokes it before it is ready.
entries.name: Proofhop

d.lore: A katydid that is a scored sourdough loaf, crust spikes and all.

entries.entry: A katydid that is a scored sourdough loaf, crust spikes and all.
entries.lore: Loafhopper is a katydid baked into a scored sourdough loaf, crust spikes and all. Its crust crackles when it jumps, and the farm smells of fresh bread for an hour wherever it lands.
entries.name: Loafhopper

d.lore: An anglerfish fry whose mouth is a tiny sprung trap.

entries.entry: An anglerfish fry whose mouth is a tiny sprung trap.
entries.lore: An anglerfish fry whose mouth is a tiny sprung trap. Lurklet dangles a little lure from its head and snaps shut on anything curious enough to come close, including fingers.
entries.name: Lurklet

d.lore: A flat anglerfish that is a living bear trap.

entries.entry: A flat anglerfish that is a living bear trap.
entries.lore: Snapler lies hidden in the mud with its jaws wide open, a flat anglerfish that is a living bear trap. The only warning is the faint glint of its lure.
entries.name: Snapler

d.lore: A walking frogfish whose whole body snaps shut like a giant trap.

entries.entry: A walking frogfish whose whole body snaps shut like a giant trap.
entries.lore: Maulangler walks along the seabed on stubby fins, and its whole body snaps shut like a giant trap. It is slow, patient and very hard to get out of once it has closed.
entries.name: Maulangler

entries.category: Secretary bird + cast iron (its dark leg feathering grown into heavy riveted iron)

d.lore: A secretary bird whose black "trousers" have turned to cast iron: two short, heavy iron stomper legs.

entries.entry: A secretary bird whose black "trousers" have turned to cast iron: two short, heavy iron stomper legs.
entries.lore: A secretary bird whose black leg feathers have turned to cast iron, leaving it with two short, heavy stomping legs. Malletary hunts by stamping, and the ground shakes every time it finds something.
entries.name: Malletary

d.lore: A baby rattlesnake with a maraca tail.

entries.entry: A baby rattlesnake with a maraca tail.
entries.lore: Rattlebub shakes its maraca tail constantly, mostly to hear itself. The baby rattlesnake keeps it going all through supper and falls asleep only when the rattle finally runs out of rhythm.
entries.name: Rattlebub

d.lore: A rattlesnake that is a pair of maracas.

entries.entry: A rattlesnake that is a pair of maracas.
entries.lore: Maracoil is a rattlesnake that is a pair of maracas, one at each end. It shakes a steady beat before it strikes, and some islanders dance to the rhythm without realising it is a warning.
entries.name: Maracoil

d.lore: A jellyfish polyp that is a walking button mushroom.

entries.entry: A jellyfish polyp that is a walking button mushroom.
entries.lore: At night Polyshroom walks out of the water and plants itself in damp soil. The jellyfish polyp is a little button mushroom on a stalk, and it is easy to mistake for an ordinary one.
entries.name: Polyshroom

d.lore: A baby jellyfish that is a spinning mushroom throwing star.

entries.entry: A baby jellyfish that is a spinning mushroom throwing star.
entries.lore: Starcap is a baby jellyfish that spins through the air like a throwing star made of gilled mushroom wedges. It drops a fine dust of spores wherever it whirls.
entries.name: Starcap

d.lore: A jellyfish whose bell is a toadstool cap.

entries.entry: A jellyfish whose bell is a toadstool cap.
entries.lore: Medushroom drifts slowly over damp forests, its bell a broad toadstool cap trailing long stinging threads. Wherever its shadow passes in the night, the ground below has sprouted a fresh ring of mushrooms by morning.
entries.name: Medushroom

entries.name: Morelkin

d.lore: A tapir that has become the truffle it was hunting.

entries.entry: A tapir that has become the truffle it was hunting.
entries.lore: Truffapir is a tapir that hunted truffles so long it became one. Its snout can find a buried truffle under a whole field, but it refuses to share where it found any.
entries.name: Truffapir

d.lore: A prehistoric giant tapir whose spine has grown into a ridge of morel towers.

entries.entry: A prehistoric giant tapir whose spine has grown into a ridge of morel towers.
entries.lore: The spine of this giant tapir has grown into a ridge of morel towers, tall enough to be seen over the treetops. Morelossus moves slowly, and the forest behind it sprouts mushrooms for weeks.
entries.name: Morelossus

entries.entry: The last thylacine as an old film's clapperboard: its famous wide gape is the striped clapper.
